criteria.description: Attribute signed evidence and compare the pinned base and head.

criteria.description: Report exact native readiness, policy deficits, and distinct maintainer and merge stages.
criteria.notes: Policy fixtures cover named pipeline, qualified counts, protected paths, stale acceptance, and historical status.

criteria.description: Offer applicable handoffs and submit reviews on the exact candidate.
criteria.notes: Action tests and signed HTTP fixture cover capability, a refused write, exact receipt, and unchanged sibling counts.

criteria.description: Preserve navigation and show controlled fallbacks for unavailable status and comparison.
